decisions.reason: The supplement range is a core part of the firm's pharmacy consumer health portfolio and fits its strategy of broadening consumer products.
The skin and hair supplement sits in a popular pharmacy beauty-from-within segment and costs little to keep within the established line.
The joint health product extends the Trivital brand into a stable segment driven by an ageing customer base.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a niche product, but post-pandemic interest in immune products likely supports keeping it.
The OTC triptan addresses a clear self-medication need in pharmacies and suits the firm's push into consumer health, though the missing website observations add uncertainty.
